comments.text:
Omg I'm having a hard time watching this. Black seed stuff is Zaatar... and muhammarra is made of walnuts and red peppers. My American husband loves it!
The "purple" pickels are pickled turnips. An absolute must have on a falafel sandwich!

Driving to my parents villages about 2hrs from Damascus, you pass a little old lady's stand where she has a straight hole in the ground where she makes her own bread (like you saw in the video but in the actual ground.) She makes those same quick lil sandwiches for you hot on the go. Absolutely mouthwatering.

comments.author: @ZenZoonay
comments.text:
I was born in Damascus... I miss street shawarma sooo much! Best falafel is in my grandparents village about 2hours from Damascus. Granted I am blessed with having this food homecooked... but to this day in all my travels, I have not found shawarma as good.
Bab-Touma is where many of my relatives live... making me very home sick watching this.

Also, the shawarma spot you hit is a place I used to frequent... beyond excellent!
